g.text: One system, every process that uses it and in what role, and the capabilities those processes support. This shows the business impact of changing the system. A long list against a low criticality rating is worth a second look.

g.title: Settle brokered CDs and keep the position
Administer deposit insurance records and escheatment
Compile, certify, and file regulatory reports
Recover and write off fraud loss
Remarket recovered collateral and pursue deficiency
Cancel ancillary products and refund unearned premium
Bill merchant fees and serve statements
Calculate and settle partner revenue share
Post recovery and account for proceeds
Refund credit balance and report unclaimed property
